name: brainbreak-community-backend
description: Vercel backend for BrainBreak's Community World: creator profiles, level publishing, likes/favorites/plays, leaderboards, and achievements. Supabase is the database; every write is authorized either by the caller's own forwarded Supabase session (RLS-enforced) or, for the small trusted set of backend-only operations, the service-role key — see api/_lib/supabaseClients.js.
